name: Progressively Optimized Local Radiance Fields
definition: A method for robust view synthesis of long video sequences by dynamically allocating new local radiance fields as the camera trajectory extends, preventing global failure from pose outliers and maintaining high resolution around the camera path.
summary: LocalRF is a view synthesis method that jointly optimizes camera poses and multiple overlapping local radiance fields from monocular video, avoiding Structure-from-Motion and scaling to unbounded scenes with fixed memory.
